title: Tuesday Quick Tip
subtitle: Comparing to teammates
hook: A player says, I'll never be as good as them.
intro: One teammate is faster and stronger.
Your player is keeping score in their head.
statement: Kids measure themselves against whoever is closest.
q1: Do you point them to their own progress —
q2: or use the teammate as an example to chase?
q3: How far has this player come since day one?
t1: There is no single right way. But confidence grows
t2: when kids compare themselves to who they were.
cta: Coaches — how do you handle comparing?
ctaLines: Personal goals. Progress check. A private word.
Their own path or a teammate to chase?
ctaPrompt: Share your habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
A player says, I'll never be as good as them.
One teammate is faster and stronger. Your player is keeping score in their head.
Kids measure themselves against whoever is closest.
Focus on their own progress or a teammate to chase. There is no single right way.
How do you handle comparing? Share your habit in the comments.
